authorization: Owner 2026-10-28: converge the existing programme into staged final research reports, prioritize already-derived four-goal results, continue feasible original work, upload needed user notes, push and hand off to the running local session; no native solver/ODE, no new unbounded research cycle.
scope: six report/analysis units plus the existing live task IDs frozen at uptake; no replacement campaign
active_packet_policy: finish or validly checkpoint the existing packet before new dispatch; never cancel/reset solely to change priority
state_policy: Use the current session state path; read-only preflight then append once. Do not initialize, overwrite, copy an archived STATE into authority or reconstruct it from publication status.
legacy_work: After initial report, keep existing original/R32/R36 tasks under their current IDs and contracts. Reuse completed outputs; continue ready/research-needed/source-resumable work. Only lack of exact input, actual capability, frozen exhausted allowance or a still-open substantive finding can remain a residual.

report_phases.S0: Already supplied baseline candidate; reconcile and qualify immediately before new science fits
report_phases.S1: Each accepted goal product includes a rendered REPORT_DELTA and figures; update only affected report chapters
report_phases.S2: Final integrated report and paper extracts after executable frozen-scope work drains

termination: Stop the finite release after all executable scoped tasks are completed/closed and the final report has rendered/reviewed outputs. Exact remaining original scientific holds remain visible. An empty READY is not enough while named existing acquisition/repair/resume remains executable; it is also not authority to create new research.
default_controller_behavior: unchanged unless these explicit next flags are used
source_qualification: Existing PUBLICATION_STATUS and raw product/review metadata describe their exact product only; source transport/lifecycle tests do not qualify MC or observational science.
